notes.title: Week 2 Update
notes.content:
We are glad to present small improvements for our game. Now we are working on creating new interesting maps and improving the previous ones. We hope to add them to the game next week.

Week 2 - Patch Notes

Added display of players online in Prepare to battle menu
Added the option of waiting for a real player in multiplayer (dont start a battle against AI)
Added translation into Spanish and French
Added more sounds on Campaign level select menu
Now you can view the closed chapters in Campaign menu

Bug Fixes
Fix a bug of endless battle loading the Chinese players
Fixed display of new wave timers after reloading battle

See you in-game,
Elementals Reborn team.

notes.title: Week 1 Update (requared client v1.06)
notes.content:
We deployed a big patch, now game server requares client version 1.06 or higher. Please, UPDATE you game to last version.

We apologize if the game did not start recently, it was for reason that the game client was not the latest version =(

Week 1 - Patch Notes

Changed the balance in many campaign levels
Improved enemys AI
Added translation into Ukrainian and German
Added restart button after defeat in campaign level
Added autofill spells in prepare to battle scene
Clicking to ESC returns you back from some menus

Bug Fixes
Fixed a problem with loading replays
Fixed displaying a window with an error message when you enter the game
FIxed some interface bugs

See you in-game,
Elementals Reborn team.
